name: Bobza Flanders
original_name: ボブザ・フランダース
source:
Bobza is the owner of a popular tavern in the capital of Leazas were many adventurers and fighters of the coliseum gather. He has many different quality wines and types of alcohol to serve, and offers a warm and casual service. 

His daughter, [url=/c50975]Pulptenks Flanders[/url], works as the waitress in the pub. He loves her very much and is very protective. 

[spoiler]When she was kidnapped during the events of Rance 01, he was crushed by the event and couldn't work on his tavern properly. Luckily, Rance rescued her, which made Bobza be overjoyed and incredibly thankful towards his benefactor.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Bobza_Flanders]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
